s: Aniyyat amen achar habberakot, ubo h' seipim: haoneh amen achar birkotayv — hare zeh megunneh, ella im ken berak shette berakot o yoter, sheyyesh achiza lazo bazo — oneh besop kullan "amen", kemo shennitbaer besiman n"d. Veyesh choleqin gam bazeh kemo shennitbaer sham. Veken minhag medinot ellu, veen leshannot hamminhag. Veachar beraka acharona shel perot vekayyotze bahem — ledibre hakkol eno oneh "amen" achar birkat atzmo, ki en lah achiza im beraka rishona, shehare rashshay lehapsiq uledabber benetayim. Veeno domeh le"yishtabbach" shehi beraka acharona achar pesuqe dezimra, veyesh lah achiza im beraka rishona shehi "baruk sheamar", lepi sheasur lehasiach beemtza pesuqe dezimra, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Abal achar birkat adam acher miyyisrael choba laanot "amen", ap al pi shehu eno mechuyyab bibraka zo kelal, vaapillu lo shemaah mittechillatah vead sopah ella sopah bilbad, o apillu lo shemaah kelal, raq shehu yodea ezo beraka hi shello tehe "amen" yetoma, kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"d. Abal nokri hambarek beraka min habberakot shettiqqenu chakamim — en onim acharayv "amen" ella im ken shama kol habberaka mippiv. Vekutim asaum kenokrim lekol dibrehem. Abal achar min, dehaynu haaduq laaboda zara — asur laanot "amen" apillu shameu kol habberaka mippiv (lepi shessetam machashebet min behazkarat hashshem hi laaboda zara). Veken mi sheshshinna matbea habberaka — en onin acharai[v] "amen". Veken en onin "amen" achar tinoq shellomed habberakot lipne rabbo, shemmuttar lelammed letinoq habberakot ketiqqunan apillu shello bizmannan, veap al pi shehem lebattala bishat hallimmud, ap al pi sheasur legadol hammitlammed. Abal kesheenan mebarekin lebattala — onin acharehem "amen", kegon shemmebarekin otan bizmannan kede liptor mechiyyuban shehem chayyabim bahen kede lechannekam bemitzvot. Veken beshaa sheqqorin hahaptara betzibbur, umebarekin lepaneha uleachareha:

Kol hambarek beraka sheenah tzerika — hare zeh nose shem shamayim lashshov, vahare hu keillu nishba lashshov, veasur laanot amen acharayv. Veap al pi shemmin hattora en issur behazkarat shem shamayim lebattala ella keshemmazkiro bedibre habay sheen bahem tzorek, velo bederek beraka ap al pi sheenah tzerika, mikkol maqom, middibre soperim asur apillu bederek beraka sheenah tzerika (abal letzorek muttar lehazkir apillu bidbar hareshut):

Asur ligrom beraka sheenah tzerika, kegon kol shene debarim sheyyakol lepotram bibraka achat — asur ligrom sheyyitztarek lachazor ulebarek, kegon sheyyapsiq benetayim besicha, o bedabar acher haggorem sheyyitztarek lachazor ulebarek. Vaapillu beshabbat shechaseru harbeh berakot mimminyan mea berakot shechayyab adam lebarek bekol yom — asur ligrom beraka sheenah tzerika kede lehashlim lemea. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyakol liptor shene debarim bibraka shehi meyuchedet lishnehem, abal im hi meyuchedet ledabar echad ella sheyyakol liptor bah gam hashsheni betorat tepela — tob yoter leharbot bibrakot, kemo shennitbaer besiman ry"b:

Lepikak, im hebiu lo perot betok hasseuda — tob yoter lehanicham leachar birkat hammazon, kede sheyyebarek acharehem birkatam haacharona hamyuchedet lahem, velo yipterem bebirkat hammazon sheenah meyuchedet lahem, veenah potartam ella mishshum shehem nechshabim mikkelal hasseuda, hoil ubau qodem shemmasheku yedehem min happat. Veim bau achar kak — teunim beraka lipnehem uleacharehem veen niptarim bebirkat hammazon, sheen birkat hammazon poteret meen g' velo "bore nepashot rabbot", kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"z ver"ch. Veyesh choleqim. Veyesh lehachamir kassebara harishona. Ubiprat beshabbat veyom tob kede lehashlim mea berakot — yesh lo lehanicham leachar birkat hammazon lehashlim bahem, velo lismok al shemiat chazarat hashsheliach tzibbur ubirkat hattora vehahaptara: seliq hilkot berakot. Tam venishlam shebach lael bore olam.
